common_myths.myth: Oximeter mein SpO2 98% aa raha hai matlab lungs bilkul theek hain, chahe saans lene mein kitni bhi dikkat kyun na ho rahi ho.
common_myths.reality: Oximeter sirf oxygen saturation batata hai—agar kisi ko tez **Saans Phoolna, Seene mein Dard, ya Asthma/CO2 issue** ho to 96% SpO2 par bhi emergency ho sakti hai! Hamesha patient ki halat pehle dekhein.

sources: WHO / MoHFW Home Monitoring Pulse Oximetry Guide
US FDA: Pulse Oximeter Accuracy and Limitations

topics.title: Ghar par Digital BP Machine se Galat Reading: Pair Latkane, Baat Karne aur Wrong Cuff Size se ±20 mmHg Error!
topics.short_hook: Ghar par digital BP monitor (Omron/Dr. Morepen etc.) par pehli baar BP 152/96 aata hai aur 2 minute baad 128/82! Log machine ko kharab bol dete hain—par asli galti machine ki hai ya baithne ke tarike aur cuff size ki?
topics.the_illusion: Digital BP machine kharab hoti hai isliye alag readings aati hain; bas kaise bhi baith kar arm par cuff baandh kar button daba do.

chemical_or_term_decoded.term: Hydrostatic & Cuff-Size Physics (टाँगें लटकाने, मोटे स्वेटर और छोटे कफ से +10 से +30 mmHg नकली हाई बीपी!)
chemical_or_term_decoded.aam_bhasha_mein: American Heart Association (AHA) ke mutabik ghar par BP naapte waqt 5 chhoti galtiyan aapka BP **falsely 10 se 30 mmHg zyada** dikha sakti hain: (1) **Peshab Roka Hona** (+10–15 mmHg), (2) **Peeth bina tek ke aur Pair hawa mein Latkana/Cross Karna** (+5–10 mmHg), (3) **Baaju ko Table par na rakh kar Neeche Latkana** (+10 mmHg), (4) **Mote Kapde/Sweater ke Upar Cuff Baandhna** (+10–40 mmHg!), aur (5) **Mote Baaju par Chhota Cuff** (+10–20 mmHg)!

topics.deep_explanation:
Ghar par liya gaya sahi BP clinic se bhi zyada reliable hota hai (kyunki clinic mein doctor dekh kar 'White-Coat Hypertension' ho jaata hai!)—bas **AHA ke 7 Golden BP Rules** follow karein:
(1) **Empty Bladder First** (pehle bathroom hokar aayein!), (2) **30 Min No Chai/Coffee/Smoking/Exercise**, (3) **5 Min Quiet Rest:** Kursi par peeth tika kar, **dono pair zameen par seedhe** (cross bilkul nahi!) rakh kar 5 minute chupchap baithein, (4) **Bare Arm at Heart Level:** Cuff **Nangi Baaju (ya bilkul patli sleeve)** par baandhein aur baaju ko table/takiye par **Dil ke Level** par tikayein, (5) **No Talking** while measuring, (6) **Use Upper-Arm Cuff (Wrist monitors aksar galat hote hain!)** aur mote baaju (32+ cm) ke liye **Large Cuff** use karein, aur (7) **Average of 2 Readings (1 min apart):** Pehli reading aksar thodi high aati hai—1 minute ruk kar doosri reading lein aur dono ka average likhein!
real_life_examples: Chai peete hue, peshab roke, sofa par pair cross kar ke mote sweater ke upar cuff baandhne par BP 158/98 aana—aur 5 min shant baith kar sahi posture mein naapne par 126/82 aana!
Har baar pehli high reading dekh kar dar ke maare ek aur BP ki goli kha lena (jisse baad mein BP dangerously low gir jaata hai!).

standards_and_limits.regulator: American Heart Association (AHA) & Indian Guidelines on Hypertension (IGH-IV)
standards_and_limits.safe_limit: Use validated **Upper-Arm** cuff (not wrist), sit quietly 5 mins with **back supported, feet flat on floor, empty bladder, bare arm supported at heart level**, take **2 readings 1 min apart**, and average them; keep a 7-day log for your doctor.
standards_and_limits.risk_category: False hypertension readings leading to unnecessary over-medication (dizziness/falls) OR missed real high BP.

impact_on_body_or_pocket.turant_asar: Galat readings dekh kar panic ya galat extra BP goli lena.
impact_on_body_or_pocket.lambe_samay_ka_asar: Sahi posture + 7-day BP logbook aapke doctor ko exact safe dosing set karne mein madad karti hai.

ghar_pe_kaise_check_karein: 5-Min Bare-Arm Average Rule: Ghar ki digital machine bilkul theek hoti hai—bas (1) Toilet hokar aayein, (2) 5 min chupchap kursi par **pair zameen par** rakh kar baithein, (3) **Nangi baaju table par** rakh kar naapein, aur (4) **1 minute baad doosri reading** lein—dono ka average hi aapka asli BP hai!

common_myths.myth: Digital BP machine hamesha galat dikhati hai—sirf purane doctor wale paare (Mercury) wali machine hi sahi hoti hai.
common_myths.reality: Validated automatic Upper-Arm digital monitors (jaise Omron/validated brands) bilkul accurate hote hain aur duniya bhar ke clinics ab mercury hata kar unhi par shift ho chuke hain—galat reading 90% baar galat posture/cuff se aati hai!

sources: American Heart Association (AHA): Monitoring Your Blood Pressure at Home
Indian Guidelines on Hypertension (IGH-IV)
